title: Cancer Free Since 2015- Featured Healing Story
content: Cancer Free Since 2015- Featured Healing StoryRadical Remission ProjectAug 10, 20202 min readUpdated: Nov 9, 2023In 2012, radical remission user cateclassen was diagnosed with stage 3 breast cancer. She initially tried conventional treatment like surgery and her doctor wanted to do additional treatments, like chemotherapy. She declined, instead, she wanted to treat her body and soul into a manageable instrument for living. Here is her story in her own words:After 2.5 years of strictly natural healing of 9 cms. of tumors spread across both breasts and lymph node involvement, I had surgery to remove the metal biopsy clip. Despite tumors disappearing I was in so much pain that they thought to check to see if I had MS, bone cancer, brain cancer, etc…. It was the metal biopsy clip causing me so much pain due to a metal allergy that I was completely bedridden in pain for almost a year. The Biopsy clip was removed in a lumpectomy and pain STOPPED immediately. (I started out with somewhere in the neighborhood of 9cms of tumors spread across both breasts. 2 years later, I had 8mm removed surgically in a lumpectomy. That’s it.I have received my “No Cancer Seen” after almost 3 years to the day.Essential Oils, Spices, enemas, juicing, The Budwig Diet, bone marrow broth, pH, emotional healing, and physical “clearing” techniques. With a lot of encouragement, I have finally begun writing about it: healingwithcate.tumblr.com/. For now, the posts are simple “breadcrumbs” for the upcoming Recipe Book. Your Life Is A Recipe ~ Add-In Good Ingredients. It is a user-friendly guide you can make your own for your own healing. I am not just talking about a cure, I am talking about the potential for HEALING through and through.EDITOR'S NOTE: As of August 2020, cateclassen is thriving.Did you know you can stay up to date with The Radical Remission Project through their monthly newsletter?
